description: Rewrites the claim to maximize defensible scope given the novelty-verdict. Enforces the smallest-spring discipline: one independent claim, ≤3 dependent claims, no `comprising` chains over 3 elements. Output: refined claim-draft. NOTE: declared input_types is `claim-draft` only — the agent ALSO reads the upstream novelty-verdict from the substrate at runtime, but it is not declared as a strict input_type to avoid the one-hop cycle the composition layer detects between this agent and novelty-searcher (which consumes claim-draft + produces novelty-verdict).
